title: Remove gapsFromDetails inference shim from BorealError
description: WHY: BorealError now accepts explicit gaps but also reconstructs them from untyped details when gaps are omitted (packages/core/src/errors.ts lines 20-25 and gapsFromDetails at line 45). Inferring enforcement gaps from arbitrary detail shapes is exactly the drift the typed contract exists to prevent - a detail payload that happens to pattern-match can fabricate a gap code the enforcement site never intended, and throw sites that rely on inference are invisible to the coverage test. WHAT: (1) enumerate every BorealError throw site currently relying on inference (throws with details but no explicit gaps whose details trigger gapsFromDetails); (2) convert each to pass explicit typed gaps; (3) delete gapsFromDetails; (4) extend tests/runtime/enforcement-gap-coverage.test.ts to assert that policy-violation errors carry explicitly-passed gaps (for example via a construction-site marker or by removing the inference path so the type system enforces it).
acceptanceCriteria: gapsFromDetails is deleted and all former inference call sites pass explicit gaps
enforcement-gap-coverage test suite passes and fails if a policy violation is thrown without explicit gaps
pnpm check and pnpm test pass
closedReason: BorealError no longer infers gaps from details
